messages:
maria: quick heads-up — seeing a perf spike on the llama3-13b prod canary after the kernel-routing tweak, p99 token latency +12% vs yesterday
kevin: saw that on staging as well, any idea which change triggered it? route-to-fast-path was the only runtime change last deploy
maria: my gut says it's an interaction between rope_theta scaling defaults + the matmul kernel selector. attached quick profile:
```
PROFILE
model: llama3-13b
seq_len=512
kernel_selected=matmul_xla_v2
matmul_forward: baseline 3.2ms -> canary 4.5ms (+40%)
attention_kv_copy: 0.6ms
kv_cache_read: 0.8ms
overall p99: 123ms -> 138ms
```
jess: cc @samir — note that some llama3 variants move to head_dim=128 in certain configs (hidden 5120, heads 40). GEMM shapes change a lot, tiling/pack alignment matters
samir: confirmed on microbench — when head_dim % 64 != 0 the XLA/packed kernel chooses a slower fallback tile. observed matmul slowdown for shapes (B, H, Hd)= (40, 128) with seq512
kevin: could be exacerbated by batching heuristics: coalesced batching groups mixed head-dim requests and forces one kernel choice for the batch
maria: interesting — so two vectors: (1) rope_theta change alters attended position scaling and cache access pattern, (2) head-dim mismatch pushes kernel selector to suboptimal path. together they regress p99
jess: also flagged: RMSNorm->SiLU fused kernel got a quant path added recently. the fusion now chooses a different codepath when quantized weights present — a slow edge-case
samir: quick repro command I ran:
```
/run microbench --model llama3-13b --seq 512 --heads 40 --hdim 128 --kernel_policy=canary-routing --batch=coalesce
```
results: matmul_xla_v2 fallback path = slower by ~35% for that shape
kevin: immediate mitigation options: 1) revert the routing tweak for llama3-13b canary 2) add head-dim-aware selector that prefers packed kernels when head_dim aligns poorly 3) tweak batcher to avoid mixing shapes in a single coalesced batch
maria: for quick canary I tried overriding rope_theta -> 0.99 in the model config for chat templates, p99 dropped ~6% (partial improvement)
jess: long term we should: - add shape-aware kernel scoring in compile-time selector - add small table of preferred kernels per (hidden, heads, head_dim) - add test to perf suite that runs representative seq lengths 32/128/512
samir: another nuance: KV cache read/write patterns change memory access locality when rope scaling changes, so GPU L2 hit rate dips and memcopy latencies tick up. profiler shows small increase in kv_cache_read time
maria: plan of action: 1) rollback routing tweak for 13b canary now 2) land a selector patch that checks head_dim%64 and prefers packed kernel when mismatch 3) change batcher default: avoid coalescing requests with seq_len>128 OR differing head configs 4) add microbench in CI
kevin: filed a hotfix PR: https://git.internal/r/1234 (revert + temp selector guard) — will trigger canary rollback
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-02-18T14:23:05 started by kevin (canary-id: c-20260218-09)
jess: also add an eval run to ensure generation quality doesn't regress when we change rope_theta override — run prompt-set A/B for chat templates
maria: agreed. I'll open tickets for the perf test cases and the kernel scoring table. tagging folks for follow-up: @kevin @jess @samir :thumbsup:
kevin: once hotfix is up i'll run a 6h canary and collect p50/p95/p99 + perf traces
maria: thanks — will monitor. any objections to the overrides for now?
samir: no objections. let's keep an eye on RMSNorm fused path too, file a follow-up if the quant path is implicated
